<script>
  // Get all URl Params
  function getAllUrlParams(url) {
    let queryString = url ? url.split('?')[1] : window.location.search.slice(1);
    let utmobj = {};
    if (queryString) {
      queryString = queryString.split('#')[0];
      let arr = queryString.split('&');
      for (let i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) {
        let a = arr[i].split('=');
        let paramName = a[0];
        let paramValue = typeof (a[1]) === 'undefined' ? "" : a[1];
        paramName = paramName.toLowerCase();
        if (paramName.match(/\[(\d+)?\]$/)) {
          let key = paramName.replace(/\[(\d+)?\]/, '');
          if (!utmobj[key]) utmobj[key] = [];
          if (paramName.match(/\[\d+\]$/)) {
            let index = /\[(\d+)\]/.exec(paramName)[1];
            utmobj[key][index] = paramValue;
          } else {
            utmobj[key].push(paramValue);
          }
        } else {
          if (!utmobj[paramName]) { 
            utmobj[paramName] = paramValue; // Set the value for the first occurrence
          } else {
            // Just overwrite with the latest value for duplicate parameters (don't create an array)
            utmobj[paramName] = paramValue; // Override with the last occurrence
          }
        }
      }
    }
    return utmobj;
  }

  // this return the cookie
  function getCookie(cname) {
    var name = cname + "=";
    var ca = document.cookie.split(';');
    for (var i = 0; i < ca.length; i++) {
      var c = ca[i];
      while (c.charAt(0) == ' ') {
        c = c.substring(1);
      }
      if (c.indexOf(name) == 0) {
        return c.substring(name.length, c.length);
      }
    }
    return "";
  }

  // Reusable function to fetch IP info
  async function fetchIPInfo() {
    try {
      const response = await fetch("https://ipinfo.io/json");
      const data = await response.json();
      // Add country code and full country name to the response
      data.countryCode = data.country;
      data.countryName = COUNTRIES_BY_CODE[data.country];
      return data;
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Error fetching IP info:", error);
      return {countryCode:"", countryName: ""};
    }
  }
  
  // Make it globally available
  window.fetchIPInfo = fetchIPInfo;

    return `https://${redirectUrl}/?${queryString}`;
	}

<script>
  // Ip address
  const userIpAndBrowserInfo = {
  ipAddress: "",
  ...getBrowserDetails()
}
function getBrowserDetails() {
  try {
    const ua = navigator.userAgent;
    let browserName = "Unknown";
    let version = "Unknown";
    if (ua.indexOf("Firefox") > -1) {
      browserName = "Firefox";
      const versionMatch = ua.split("Firefox/")[1];
      version = versionMatch ? versionMatch : "Unknown";
    } else if (ua.indexOf("Chrome") > -1 && ua.indexOf("Edg/") === -1) {
      browserName = "Chrome";
      const versionMatch = ua.split("Chrome/")[1];
      version = versionMatch ? versionMatch.split(" ")[0] : "Unknown";
    } else if (ua.indexOf("Safari") > -1 && ua.indexOf("Chrome") === -1) {
      browserName = "Safari";
      const versionParts = ua.split("Version/");
      if (versionParts.length > 1) {
        version = versionParts[1].split(" ")[0];
      } else {
        // Fallback for iOS Safari without Version/ string
        version = "Unknown";
      }
    } else if (ua.indexOf("Edg/") > -1) {
      browserName = "Edge";
      const versionMatch = ua.split("Edg/")[1];
      version = versionMatch ? versionMatch : "Unknown";
    } else if (ua.indexOf("Trident/") > -1) {
      browserName = "Internet Explorer";
      const versionParts = ua.split("rv:");
      if (versionParts.length > 1) {
        version = versionParts[1].split(")")[0];
      }
    }
    return {
      browserName: browserName,
      browserVersion: version
    };
  } catch (error) {
    console.warn("Error detecting browser details:", error);
    return {
      browserName: "Unknown",
      browserVersion: "Unknown"
    };
  }
}
